title: Service Advisor
description:
Role - Service Advisor / Service Receptionist

Location - Chester

Salary - £30,000 Basic Salary £38,000 Realistic OTE Overtime Available

1 in 4 Saturday Mornings

Richard Abson Group is delighted to be assisting a prestigious automotive dealership in Chester in their search for an experienced Service Advisor / Service Receptionist.

Representing one of the industry's leading premium brands, this dealership forms part of a highly respected dealer group renowned for investing in its people. You'll benefit from ongoing manufacturer training, genuine career progression, and the opportunity to work within a modern, forward-thinking business embracing the latest hybrid and electric vehicle technology.

As the first point of contact for customers, you'll play a key role in delivering an exceptional aftersales experience. You'll manage service bookings, provide vehicle progress updates, explain technical information in a customer-friendly manner, and identify opportunities to promote service plans and additional aftersales products.

Working Hours:
- Monday to Friday, 8am-6pm
- 1 in 4 Saturday mornings, paid at overtime

What we're looking for:
- Minimum of 1 year's experience as a Service Advisor or in a similar aftersales role within a franchised main dealership
- A passion for delivering outstanding customer service with a proactive sales approach
- Experience using Kerridge and 1 Link would be advantageous, although not essential
- Excellent communication and organisational skills
- A professional and customer-focused approach

Salary & Benefits:
- £30,000 basic salary
- £38,000 realistic OTE
- Uncapped bonus opportunities, including hours sold, service plans and upsell/cross-sell performance
- Current team members are consistently exceeding their bonus targets
- 1 in 4 Saturday mornings, paid at overtime
- Manufacturer training and genuine career progression
- Opportunity to work with the latest hybrid and electric vehicle technology

If you're an experienced Service Advisor or Service Receptionist looking to join a premium main dealership that genuinely invests in its people, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Finance Assistant
description:

Finance Assistant - Sales Ledger & Invoicing
12 Month Fixed Term Contract

We are currently recruiting for a Finance Assistant to join a well-established business on a 12-month fixed term contract.
This is a fantastic opportunity for someone with previous sales ledger, invoicing or general finance experience to join a busy and supportive finance team.
Working within a collaborative finance function, you will be responsible for supporting a variety of sales ledger and finance administration activities, ensuring customer accounts are maintained accurately and financial transactions are processed efficiently.

Key Responsibilities
- Assist with the day-to-day running of the sales ledger, ensuring customer accounts are maintained accurately.
- Raise and process customer invoices, including recharges and sundry invoicing.
- Process customer credits and support the administration of claims.
- Investigate and resolve customer account queries in a timely manner.
- Raise purchase orders, ensuring accurate coding and appropriate authorisation.
- Liaise with internal departments and external customers to resolve finance-related queries.
- Maintain accurate financial records and ensure all transactions comply with company procedures.
- Assist with audit requirements and provide supporting documentation when required.
- Provide general administrative support to the wider finance team.

About You
- Previous experience in a Sales Ledger, Accounts Receivable, Finance Assistant or Accounts Assistant role would be advantageous.
- Good understanding of invoicing and general accounting processes.
- Strong attention to detail with a high level of accuracy.
- Confident using Excel and finance systems
- Excellent communication skills with the ability to build relationships across different departments.
- Highly organised with the ability to prioritise workloads and meet deadlines.
- A proactive and flexible approach, with a willingness to learn.
- AAT qualified or studying towards a qualification would be beneficial but is not essential.

What's on Offer?
- 12-month fixed term contract.
- Opportunity to join a well-established and reputable business.
- Friendly, supportive and experienced finance team.
- Varied role offering exposure to different areas of finance.
- Excellent opportunity to further develop your finance experience and skills.

If you have previous sales ledger or finance administration experience and are looking for your next opportunity, we'd love to hear from you. Apply today for further information.

title: Credit Control & Accounts Payable Administrator
company: Kenneth Brian Associates Limited - Agency - Permanent
description:
Kenneth Brian Associates are working with the head office of a market leading service and distribution business based in Ellesmere Port. We are looking to hire a candidate with a background in Credit Control and Accounts Payable. The role is split 50/50.

This vacancy is hybrid with the option to work 4 days from home and 1 day in the office per week. This is initially a 9-month contract and will become permanent after this period.

This role reports remotely to the Finance Manager based in SE England.

Credit Control:

Provide effective management of queries relating to the operation of the trading accounts.

Meet collection targets agreed, by proactive Credit Control through telephone and other appropriate media

Produce through SAP daily factoring reports to submit on 3rd party factoring company online platforms

Whilst maintaining good customer relations to retain business, collect trade debt within the agreed credit limit and clear any excess balance with immediate effect.

Where applicable, liaise closely with External Sales Representatives and Product Managers to ensure the effective management of their accounts.

Run invoices daily, produce daily reports showing orders unable to be invoiced and distribute to the relevant people for resolution.

Allocate daily cash, ensure all contra items are allocated, and customer accounts are kept as clean as possible.

Accounts Payable:

Process and post purchase invoices, staff expense claims, and other relevant documents, using SAP and interfaced ERP systems.

Ensure the European VAT numbers quoted by suppliers on invoices are correct

Resolved unmatched invoice issues

Respond to telephone and email enquiries from suppliers

Open and maintain SAP supplier accounts

Liaise with suppliers, maintain accurate vendor details in the financial database, and resolve any invoice or payment-related queries.

Prepare and process payments to suppliers via BACS, and other methods for multi-currency.

Reconcile supplier statements and assist in creating purchase ledger reports and other financial reports.

Accurately calculate Value Added Tax (VAT) for purchased items, for both UK and European VAT registrations
working_arrangement_text: 4 days from home / 1 day in office

title: Conveyancing Administrator (Hybrid)
description:
Job Title: Conveyancing Administrator

Location: Ellesmere Port

Job Type: Permanent, Full Time

Working Pattern: Office-based with potential for hybrid working

About the Role

We are seeking an organised and enthusiastic Conveyancing Administrator to join our modern Ellesmere Port office. This is an excellent opportunity to provide administrative support to our busy and friendly residential conveyancing team, working alongside three Fee Earners.

The role would suit someone with previous administrative experience within a conveyancing or legal environment who enjoys working in a fast-paced office, has excellent attention to detail, and takes pride in providing high-quality support to colleagues and clients.

Key Responsibilities
- Providing administrative support to the residential conveyancing team.
- Opening new client files and carrying out onboarding procedures.
- Preparing standard correspondence and legal documentation using templates.
- Assisting with file management, scanning, photocopying, filing, and archiving.
- Requesting searches and uploading search results to case management systems.
- Liaising with clients, estate agents, lenders, and solicitors to obtain information and provide updates.
- Answering telephone and email enquiries and directing them appropriately.
- Updating case management systems to ensure client files are accurate and up to date.
- Assisting with completion packs and post-completion administration.
- Supporting the team with general office and administrative duties as required.

Requirements
- Previous experience in a conveyancing, legal administration, or similar administrative role (preferred).
- Good understanding of the residential conveyancing process.
- Excellent organisational skills and attention to detail.
- Strong communication skills, both written and verbal.
- Ability to prioritise workload and work effectively within a team.
- Competent in Microsoft Office and case management systems.
- Professional, friendly, and client-focused approach.

What We Offer
- Competitive salary.
- 20 days' holiday plus bank holidays.
- Additional day off for your birthday
- Christmas office shutdown (in addition to annual leave).
- Modern offices in Ellesmere Port.
- Supportive and friendly working environment.
- Potential for hybrid working.
- Opportunities for training and career development.

How to Apply

If you have experience in conveyancing administration or legal support and are looking to join a progressive firm offering excellent benefits and a positive working environment, we would love to hear from you.

description:

- 24 days annual leave plus your birthday off
- Hybrid Working - Office working days - Tue, Wed, Fri - From home Monday and Thursday (once Trained)

Pay & Bill Administrator Role

We are recruiting for an organised and detail-focused Pay & Bill Administrator to join an established team in Chester, supporting the day-to-day processing of worker payments and client invoicing across multiple agencies.

Reporting to the Operations Manager, you will be responsible for processing timesheets, reviewing payroll submissions, coordinating worker payments and producing accurate client invoices in line with individual agency and client requirements.

This is a varied, deadline-driven role requiring strong administrative skills, excellent attention to detail and the ability to manage queries efficiently. You will work closely with agency contacts and the wider team to ensure all pay and bill processes are completed accurately, consistently and on time.

Pay & Bill Administrator Responsibilities
- Processing agency timesheets and coordinating payments to workers across a variety of payment methods
- Reviewing agency payroll submissions to ensure accuracy and completeness
- Ensuring all weekly worker payments are processed accurately and within agreed deadlines
- Producing and issuing client invoices in the required format, including supporting documentation
- Checking pay and bill requests to ensure all relevant paperwork is received before processing
- Responding to and resolving payroll queries relating to payments, holiday pay, P45 requests and other worker enquiries
- Identifying invoice discrepancies and arranging amendments or credit notes where required
- Escalating invoice queries and adjustments to the relevant senior team member
- Providing administrative support, including data entry, filing, scanning and document management
- Maintaining accurate records and ensuring information is correctly entered into company systems
- Working closely with agency contacts to maintain consistent processes and best practice
- Following company policies and procedures across all payroll and invoicing activities
- Supporting the wider team with additional duties as required

Pay & Bill Administrator Requirements
- Previous experience in payroll, pay and bill, accounts administration or a similar administrative role
- Strong attention to detail and a high level of accuracy when processing information
- Good organisational skills and the ability to meet weekly deadlines
- Confident using computer systems and Microsoft Office
- Strong communication skills, with the ability to handle queries professionally
- A proactive approach to resolving discrepancies and addressing issues
- The ability to manage a varied workload and prioritise tasks effectively
- A reliable, methodical approach to working with confidential information
- The ability to work independently and contribute positively to a team

If this sounds like the sort of role you'd be interested in, or you'd like to find out a little more, please get in touch with Jodie Cooper at .

We are committed to diversity and inclusion. We welcome all applicants of identity, personal characteristics, or background.

title: Purchase Ledger Assistant
description:
Benefits:
- Competitive salary depending on experience
- 28 days holiday including Bank Holidays plus additional time off for Christmas shutdown
- On-site parking
- Health & wellbeing programme
- Pension
- Bereavement leave

Company Overview:

We are seeking an organised and detail-oriented Purchase Ledger Assistant to support a busy finance department based in the Winsford area.

The ideal candidate will be a reliable addition to the Finance Team and will be responsible for maintaining an accurate purchase ledger, processing payments and ensuring smooth communication between internal and external stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities for our Purchase Ledger Assistant:
- Transaction Operations: Keep financial engines running smoothly by meticulously managing the purchase ledger and ensuring all AP data is accurate and current
- Statement Reconciliation: Perform regular reconciliations of supplier statements against internal records, investigating any discrepancies
- GRNI Reconciliation: Actively monitor and reconcile the Goods Received Not Invoiced (GRNI) account, investigating aging purchase orders and unmatched receipts to ensure accurate inventory valuations
- Payment Processing: Process supplier payments accurately and on time
- Query Resolution: Serve as a point of contact for purchase ledger queries, actively liaising with internal departments, suppliers and service providers to resolve issues
- Reporting: Generate and distribute weekly and monthly reports for the management team
- General Administration: Answer incoming calls, directing them to the appropriate team members or handling baseline financial inquiries
- Ad-hoc Duties: Undertake additional administrative and financial tasks as required to support the wider department

Essential Skills and Experience Required for our Purchase Ledger Assistant:
- Experience: Proven experience in a Purchase Ledger, Accounts Payable, or similar finance administration role
- Qualifications: AAT qualified, or actively studying towards an AAT qualification (Level 2 or above), is highly preferred
- Software Proficiency: Hands-on experience using Oracle NetSuite is required and must be comfortable and efficient working within a paperless, cloud-based accounting environment
- Technical Knowledge: Solid understanding of the Accounts Payable lifecycle, including purchase order matching and GRNI (Goods Received Not Invoiced) reconciliations
- Attention to Detail: Meticulous accuracy when processing data, auditing purchase orders and reconciling complex supplier statements
- Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the confidence to professionally liaise with suppliers, service providers and internal management to resolve disputes Organisation & Time Management: Strong ability to multitask, manage high-volume workloads and consistently meet weekly reporting and payment deadlines

Schedule: Monday to Friday, 37.75 hours per week, office-based

Location: Winsford CW7

Apply today: Early interview and start date available for the successful candidate

title: Legal Assistant / Legal Secretary
description:
An opportunity has arisen for a Legal Assistant / Legal Secretary to join a law firm specialising in family law, private client matters and property law, with a focus on legal expertise and client care.

As a Legal Assistant / Legal Secretary, you will provide secretarial and administrative assistance to solicitors handling Wills, Trusts and Probate matters.

This permanent role can be either full-time or part-time offering salary range of £23,000 - £26,000 and benefits.

You will be responsible for:
- Producing correspondence and legal documents using audio typing and word processing.
- Preparing documents, forms and statements relating to client matters.
- Maintaining client files, including filing, opening, closing, storage and retrieval.
- Organising appointments and meetings, maintaining diaries and monitoring upcoming tasks.
- Preparing outgoing post and arranging document copying.
- Updating client information on the firm's computer systems.
- Amending standard documents and precedents when instructed.
- Passing on messages, emails and other correspondence promptly and accurately.

What we are looking for
- Previous experience as a Legal Secretary or Legal Assistant, ideally gained within a law firm.
- Experience in a Private Client department dealing with Wills, Trusts and Probate is desirable but not essential.
- Good organisational skills, including the ability to manage diaries and maintain accurate records.
- Computer literacy and experience using word-processing software.
- A professional and approachable manner when dealing with clients and colleagues.
- A reliable approach to work and a commitment to providing a good standard of client service.

The candidates from the following background will be considered:
- Legal Secretary, Legal Assistant, Legal Administrator, Legal clerk, Private Client Legal Secretary, Private Client Secretary, Private Client Legal Assistant, Private Client Assistant or in a similar role.

What's on offer
- Competitive Salary.
- Pension scheme.
- Christmas office closure.
- Paid sick leave, subject to eligibility.
- Full-time or part-time working arrangements.
- Annual leave, with additional entitlement linked to length of service.
- An additional birthday day off after the qualifying service period.

This is a great opportunity for a Legal Assistant / Legal Secretary to develop their experience and further enhance their career.
